# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** Forty-five  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v2 c30 P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)</sub>
- **Origin:** Grafton  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 c21 P31](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0031)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P38](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0038)</sub>; Mother Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a short, dainty, sweet-faced woman with snow-white wavy hair styled in puffs and coils. Her face is girlish and pink-cheeked with brown eyes that have golden glints, a soft voice, and dimples. She dresses in girlish, frilly clothes, such as a cream-colored muslin with pale roses, or a forget-me-not organdy.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v2 c23 P7](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0007), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 c28 P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027)_

## Personality

Miss Lavendar is imaginative, romantic, and youthful at heart, often playing pretend games to cope with loneliness. Though usually sweet, cheerful, and hospitable, she can be sulky, proud, and stubborn when hurt. She loves company and youth, expressing a deep desire for affection while remaining sensitive and emotionally imaginative.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c21 P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## Abilities

- Cooking and baking  <sub>[v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064)</sub>

## Goals

- To keep her youthful heart and enjoy imaginative companionship  <sub>[v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)</sub>
- To reunite with her old love, Stephen Irving  <sub>[v2 c28 P42](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0042), [v2 c28 P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071)</sub>

## History

Miss Lavendar Lewis spent twenty-five years living a retired life at Echo Lodge in Grafton after a youthful engagement with Stephen Irving was broken due to a foolish quarrel and her own stubborn pride. To combat her loneliness, she created an imaginary world, pretending to host tea parties and imagining a little dream-boy as her child. Anne Shirley and Diana Barry discovered her house by accident while lost, and Anne instantly recognized her as a kindred spirit. Anne later brought Stephen's son, Paul Irving, to meet her. Realizing Stephen was back in Prince Edward Island, Anne arranged a meeting between the former lovers. Stephen visited Miss Lavendar at Echo Lodge, and they reconciled after twenty-five years apart. They were married in the garden under the honeysuckle trellis the following August, subsequently leaving for a wedding trip to the Pacific coast before moving to Boston with Paul and Charlotta the Fourth.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P31](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0031), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c23 P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c28 P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 c28 P42](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0042), [v2 c28 P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 c28 P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071), [v2 c29 P10](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0010), [v2 c30 P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)_

## Background by volume

- Named Lavendar by her father because her parents fell in love in a room scented with lavender  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- Became engaged to Stephen Irving as a young woman, but they broke up after a foolish quarrel and her sulkiness  <sub>[v2 c23 P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
- Lived alone for years at Echo Lodge in Grafton with a hired girl named Charlotta  <sub>[v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> I don't believe I could live at times if I didn't pretend things. I'm not often caught at it though, and Charlotta the Fourth never tells. But I'm glad to be caught today, for you have really come and I have tea all ready for you.  <sub>[v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)</sub>

> A person must have some compensations. I don't believe I could live at times if I didn't pretend things.  <sub>[v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)</sub>

> There is nothing in my life but echoes . . . echoes of lost hopes and dreams and joys. They're beautiful and mocking.  <sub>[v2 c27 P35](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0035)</sub>

> I'm really a very happy, contented little person in spite of my broken heart. My heart did break, if ever a heart did... But, Anne, a broken heart in real life isn't half as dreadful as it is in books.  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
